title: Shujinkou no Osananajimi ga, Wakiyaku no Ore ni Guigui Kuru
titleRomaji: Shujinkou no Osananajimi ga, Wakiyaku no Ore ni Guigui Kuru
titleNative: 主人公の幼馴染が、脇役の俺にグイグイくる
synopsis: Kazuki Ishii has his life turned upside down — and is driven to suicide — after getting caught up in the romantic entanglements of his friend Teruhito Amada, who is wildly popular with the opposite sex, like the hero of a romantic comedy. However, a miracle occurs, and time is rewound back to the morning of his high school entrance ceremony. In his second chance at life, Kazuki tries to keep a low profile, avoid making friends, and live a peaceful life. But for some reason, Meiko Hikata — Amada’s childhood friend and a cool beauty known as the “Ice Empress”—begins to take an interest in him. (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Myther
synopsis: In the 2nd year of Enka, a scientist invented Myther, a device designed to create an ideal personality. With it, people could become their ideal selves and break away from their weak selves. However, underneath the surface, Myther Crime - a hidden social issue - has emerged, where those who abuse Myther suffer from their minds breaking, before carrying out horrific acts of violence. Kyou, an agent of the Special Intelligence Agency under direct command of the Japanese authorities, secretly takes on the fight against these crimes. All for the sake of his unwavering loyalty to the government… (Source: Kodansha, translated)

synopsis: My beautiful, big-breasted childhood friend, Mikoto, is completely in love with me. It sounds like a dream scenario that anyone would envy — but there’s just one big problem... She’s turned into a clingy, mentally unstable mess with love that's way too heavy!! This is a dark everyday comedy about being at the mercy of Mikoto’s unstable behavior and unintentional sexiness. Note: Mikoto-chan wa Kirawaretakunai! began as a web manga shared on the author's Twitter starting February 15, 2023, and has been published in print by Kadokawa since January 18, 2024.

title: Perfectly Fine on My Own, So My Fiancé Can Twist in the Wind
titleRomaji: Ohitorisama ni wa Naremashita node. Konyakusha Houchichuu!
titleEnglish: Perfectly Fine on My Own, So My Fiancé Can Twist in the Wind
titleNative: おひとり様には慣れましたので。 婚約者放置中!
synonyms: Enjoy My Solitude! Leave My Fiancé Alone
synopsis: Noble young lady Nicole has had her heart broken more times than she can count. Her fiancé Keios is so devoted to Princess Caroline, his childhood friend and the unrivalled belle of their aristocratic academy, that he seems to forget Nicole even exists. But no longer. Tired of waiting around and conforming to Keios’ needs, Nicole makes a most liberating decision: I’ll give up on love and go it alone. Her arranged marriage may be unavoidable, but that doesn’t mean she can’t enjoy her own life, right? Emboldened and excited, Nicole begins to shine as she never had before—so brightly, in fact, that even the clueless Keios can’t help but notice… (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Toumei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita.
titleRomaji: Toumei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita.
titleNative: 透明な夜に駆ける君と、目に見えない恋をした。
synonyms: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
synopsis: On an April night in Tokyo, still too early for fireworks, university student Kakeru Sorano meets a woman named Koharu Fuyutsuki. She is a beautiful girl who stands out from the crowd, laughs a lot, and exudes a warmth that contrasts sharply with Kakeru's own introversion. But there was something Kakeru didn't know at first—she can't see. Unlike Kakeru, Koharu hasn't given up on anything, even with her blindness. She attends university daily, shows interest in clubs, makes friends—and dreams of launching fireworks one day. Kakeru wonders why, when she can't see them...but maybe it doesn't matter. And maybe he can start moving forward, too, for the girl who's always been by his side (Source: Yen Press)

synopsis: Hokkaido is an island of extreme cold. There, scientists and members of the Japanese self-defence force investigate a mysterious animal attack, and discover a frozen mummy in a cave. Mankind has encountered the "Higher Tribe" and falls into despair. (Source: LINE Manga, translated)

synopsis: Kitami, a boy serving as class representative, is struggling to get a girl named Toujou — who transferred into the class in the middle of the semester — to fit in better with the class. But try as he might, his effort just goes nowhere. That's the situation when one day, a theft incident occurs in class. Toujou is suspected of being the culprit and becomes the target of bullying. Kitami desperately tries to stand up for her, but he gradually becomes isolated... (Source: Gangan Online, translated)

title: Whirlpool in Vernal Reverie
synopsis: Introverted high schooler Xuting is used to being the target of bullies, but her life takes a dramatic turn when a new, mysteriously handsome repairman intervenes. Captivated by his quiet strength and grateful for his protection, Xuting feels an undeniable pull towards him. Yet, her world shatters when she stumbles upon his terrifying secret: he's a werewolf. Now, caught between burgeoning feelings and monstrous danger, Xuting must navigate a terrifying new reality where her protector might just be her greatest threat. (Source: WebComics)
